_entries.content:
The issue "proxy isatty" in `rich` was addressed by ensuring that the `FileProxy` class correctly reports the TTY status of the underlying file object when wrapped.

I made the following changes in `rich/file_proxy.py`:
1. Imported the `os` module.
2. Added an `isatty()` method to `FileProxy` which delegates the check to `os.isatty(self.__file.fileno())`.

Verification using `pytest tests/test_file_proxy.py` passed after the modification.

The patch has been submitted.
